title: North-pole stereographic projection to equatorial plane verification fixture
purpose: Precisely represent an invertible stereographic mapping with declared excluded pole and document a separate orthographic drawing projection.

mathematical_structure.metric: round sphere induced Euclidean metric; projected drawing does not preserve distances
mathematical_structure.topology: smooth 2-sphere with excluded north pole, homeomorphic to R^2

maps.name: sphere_to_plane
maps.singularities: Analytically undefined at N; binary64 reference additionally excludes denom<=1e-14

parameters.meaning: point on unit sphere away from N

parameters.admissible_set: R^2 with finite and representable squared radius

assumptions.statement: Sphere radius equals one and projection plane is z=0.
Projection center is N=(0,0,1), excluded from the mathematical map domain.
SVG is an independent orthographic camera view using orthonormal axes; not metric preserving.

invariants.statement: pi(pi^{-1}(u,v))=(u,v) where computations are numerically resolved.
N, P, and the plane image Q lie on one straight 3D line.

numerical.representation: Python math binary64 projection and inverse, separately generated exact-construction SVG with rounded display coordinates
numerical.precision: IEEE-754 binary64; display is orthographic with coordinates rounded to three decimals

uncertainty.representation: None: exact analytic coordinate mapping with bounded floating-point representation

limitations: Projection is undefined at the north pole and extreme neighborhoods can be underresolved.
Orthographic SVG camera display is not isometric to intrinsic sphere geometry.
No external empirical sustainability or resilience outcome is represented.
